description: This file contains JavaScript code for the Mozaik email template builder, including helper functions for generating HTML snippets, managing editor UI, integrating TinyMCE editor, and handling style manipulations.

methods.name: getThumbnailListHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for a list of thumbnail images with labels, used for template selection.

methods.name: getEditorListHTML
methods.description: Creates HTML for the editor's layout controls, including resize handler.

methods.name: getEditorListElementHTML
methods.description: Builds HTML for individual editor elements with tools like move, delete, copy, and source.

methods.name: getToolPluginIconListHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for tool plugin icons with callbacks.

methods.name: getMozaikInnerHTML
methods.description: Wraps inner content in a div with styling and optional data attributes.

methods.name: getAceHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML for the Ace code editor interface.

methods.name: getClearHTML
methods.description: Provides HTML for a clear div used as a layout helper.

methods.name: refreshWidthSet
methods.description: Adjusts the position of width resize handlers based on current width.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Sets the maximum width for editor elements and updates layout accordingly.
